belief_update: I know I’m not broken, but I still feel like I should be able to handle things. I don’t tell people how much it affects me, even though I know they wouldn’t think less of me. Some days I feel like hiding it is the only way to keep going, other days I wonder why I even bother. I don’t know if others would treat me differently if they knew, but I keep it quiet anyway. I don’t let anyone see how much it takes to get through the day. I don’t know if this means I’m not as strong as I could be, or if I’m just trying too hard to prove I am.
